claims.ledger_statement: For every smooth complex Fano X of pseudoindex at least two, every numerical beta represented by a nonconstant free map, and every very ample H=-aK_X, the numerical-degree point descendant <tau_(d-2)(pt)>_beta is at least (a*d)^(-(d-1)).
claims.hypotheses: Smooth connected complex projective Fano, pseudoindex >=2, nonconstant free representative, each permitted positive integral very ample multiplier a, rational numerical-degree invariants.
claims.attribution: Same proposition and geometric chain occur in the supplied OpenAI manuscript; old ledger associates this proof with engineer:gpt-6.1-sol. No distinct original Argus theorem is established.
claims.open_status: No specific gap found in the scoped argument; external foundations retained, no kernel verification, Host acceptance pending.

claims.open_status: No specific proof gap found under the stated rational-curve hypothesis. No novelty or significance certification and no Host acceptance.

claims.open_status: No boundary unobstructedness is asserted. Latest assumptions are required; v1-v3 are not separate results.

claims.open_status: No sign gap found: coefficient and cotangent characters are inverted together. The affine sample tests alone would not prove the line-bundle identity.
